snippet.title: SITTER - RELEASE TRAILER
snippet.description:
Game - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3751490

Investigating the mysterious death of his grandmother, a detective breaks into her home to discover the truth, but the dwelling begins to play tricks on him. The space breaks, fears become flesh, and there is still no way out. Every step, every new room, every cycle is a chance to go mad.
